'''Oversized cards''' are Decipher Star Wars CCG premiums printed larger than the 63×88&nbsp;mm playing card. The 5×7 show premiums were given for spending $20 at the Decipher convention store, or packed as [[Reflections]] box toppers. Magazine inserts sit beside them: an InQuest [[Princess Leia Organa]] (about 3.5×5 with a punch-out miniature), a Scrye [[Boba Fett]] sticker, and an undersized InQuest [[R'kik D'nec, Hero Of The Dune Sea]] punch-out. They sit beside [[Promotional Foils]] (normal-size tournament foils). This page is the collecting list; Mara Jade's two 5×7s are treated at length on [[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]].<ref name="bgg-42">[https://boardgamegeek.com/filepage/33565/star-wars-ccg-complete-card-list-42 Star Wars CCG Complete Card List 4.2], Whaleyland, BoardGameGeek (22 August 2012). Oversized: Hunt Down & Destroy the Jedi and Mind What You Have Learned (Reflections I box toppers); Aurra Sing, Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand, and Mara Jade, Corran Horn & Talon Karrde (spend $20 or more at Decipher Store at conventions); Princess Leia Organa (InQuest magazine insert).</ref>

[[File:Oversized Mara Jade The Emperor's Hand scale.jpg|thumb|right|320px|5×7 [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] held next to the regular-size [[Enhanced Jabba's Palace]] original.<ref name="ccg-collector">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=frvqLMqMc14 Guide - SW:CCG Collection - Oversized/Undersized Cards], The CCG Collector (29 November 2015). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-frvqLMqMc14 Internet Archive].</ref>]]

== Convention 5×7 (spend $20) ==

[[File:Oversized Mara Jade The Emperor's Hand.jpg|thumb|right|240px|[[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] 5×7, signed by [[Shannon Baksa]] as Mara Jade in San Diego.]]
[[File:Oversized Aurra Sing.jpg|thumb|right|240px|[[Aurra Sing (AI)]] 5×7 in hand, with the group 5×7 at left.<ref name="boardmatt">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5q_ufwHceDM Star Wars CCG - Oversized, Undersized and Oddly Sized Cards! All you need to know!], BoardMatt (19 June 2022). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-5q_ufwHceDM Internet Archive].</ref>]]

Three 5×7 show premiums were given for spending $20 at the Decipher store at conventions:<ref name="bgg-42" />

* [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] (copyright 2000). Same photograph and game text as the [[Enhanced Jabba's Palace]] premium. Star Wars Collectors Archive item 11259 (Duncan Jenkins, 5×7, year 2000).<ref name="swca-11259">[http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11259 Premium Oversize Card, Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand], Star Wars Collectors Archive.</ref>
* [[Aurra Sing (AI)]] (copyright 2001). [[Michonne Bourriague]] portrayed Aurra Sing for Decipher. Star Wars Collectors Archive item 11258.<ref name="swca-11258">[http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11258 Premium Oversize Card, Aurra Sing], Star Wars Collectors Archive. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130621135247/http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11258 Wayback, 21 June 2013].</ref>
* ''•Mara Jade & •Corran Horn & •Talon Karrde'' (copyright 2001). Unique among the oversized cards: no normal-sized counterpart. Destiny 3, Power 8, Ability 5, Deploy 8, Forfeit 9, Pilot and Warrior, Force-Sensitive. Lore: "Each driven by a dubious past, these scoundrels now plan for the greater good of the New Republic. Found in the strangest places." The game-text box is blank. Back: Rebel Alliance symbol, decipher.com, starwars.com. Star Wars Collectors Archive item 11260.<ref name="swca-11260">[http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11260 Premium Oversize Card, Mara Jade, Corran Horn & Talon Karrde], Star Wars Collectors Archive.</ref>

[[File:Oversized Aurra Sing signed.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Aurra Sing (AI)]] 5×7 signed by [[Michonne Bourriague]].]]
[[File:Oversized Mara Jade Corran Horn Talon Karrde signed.jpg|thumb|right|240px|''•Mara Jade & •Corran Horn & •Talon Karrde'' 5×7, signed by Baksa, Michael A. Stackpole, and Timothy Zahn.]]

Radio Free Decipher (22 June 2001), reported the next day by Yarua on TheForce.net: Decipher would make the group card available at Origins, San Diego Comic-Con, GenCon, Wizard World, and DragonCon so fans could get autographs from Shannon Baksa (Mara Jade), Michael A. Stackpole (Corran Horn), and Timothy Zahn (Talon Karrde). "No Game Text (you'll need room for autographs!)" The three had been shot together when Decipher photographed the individual [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] cards.<ref name="tfn-rfd">[https://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Yaruas_RFD_Report_622628_72011.asp Yarua's RFD Report (6.22–6.28)], TheForce.net (23 June 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20150215035122/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/yaruas_rfd_report_622628_72011.asp Wayback, 15 February 2015].</ref>

[[File:Oversized Mara Jade Corran Horn Talon Karrde.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Unsigned group 5×7, lore readable.]]
[[File:Oversized Mara Jade Corran Horn Talon Karrde back.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Back of the group 5×7.]]

== Reflections I box toppers ==

Each [[Reflections]] display included one of two 5×7 double-sided objective cards. They are promotional and are not part of the 114 pack foils.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Wayback, 9 October 2026].</ref>

[[File:Reflections-box-toppers.png|640px]]

''Oversized box toppers. Standard-size cards in the same photo are for scale only.''

[[File:Oversized Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi scale.jpg|thumb|right|320px|5×7 [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]] and [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can]] on the table next to a regular-size Hunt Down.<ref name="ccg-collector" />]]

* [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can]]

Star Wars Collectors Archive item 11243 catalogs the Mind What You Have Learned 5×7 as a Reflections box topper.<ref name="swca-11243">[http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11243 Premium Oversize Card, Mind What You Have Learned], Star Wars Collectors Archive. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130622033612/http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11243 Wayback, 22 June 2013].</ref>
